Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round nine

Diagonal, with depth

Round eight’s 04, turned and given depth. The docked pair, BRD4 and VHL fitted to each other with a hairline gap and the SELFTAC pearl between them, is turned so the seam runs on a diagonal. Texture lines are back to make it more 3D: lines at an even depth inside each protein’s edge (traced as true contours, so they never tangle), shading kept to the side away from the light, a highlight, or the real surface contours from the 5T35 trace. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.

Diagonal, layered

04 turned so the seam between the proteins runs on a diagonal, with two lines inside each protein at an even depth from its edge, like contours on a surface.

The cleanest way to add depth: the lines follow each protein’s own shape, so it stays a protein outline.
